events.quote: March 2024: Eurobonds consisting of €850 million guaranteed Notes paying 3.750% coupon and maturing in 2031.
events.summary: easyJet issued a euro-denominated guaranteed bond under its EMTN programme, maturing in 2031.
events.title: Eurobond issued under EMTN programme

events.quote: In May, we finalised the acquisition of the SR Technics Malta maintenance facility and welcomed 400 highly skilled and valued new colleagues.
events.summary: easyJet completed the acquisition of the SR Technics Malta maintenance facility and welcomed its skilled new colleagues.
events.title: Acquisition of SR Technics Malta maintenance facility

events.quote: 16 NEO aircraft joined the fleet, with a further 299 on order.
events.summary: NEO aircraft joined the fleet during the year, with a large number still on order.
events.title: Fleet renewal with NEO aircraft deliveries

events.quote: Unfortunately, despite easyJet being fully prepared for this summer, we saw operational challenges outside of our control, in particular with air traffic control (ATC), which was the single biggest source of delays this year across the network.
events.summary: Air traffic control was the biggest source of delays, and easyJet made schedule changes to limit knock-on effects.
events.title: Air traffic control disruption and schedule changes

events.quote: Significant investment in spares made during the year, continuing a trend started in 2023. Global supply-chain issues with spares means that it is no longer viable to run a just-in-time spares process due to delivery delays, and so we have made this investment to minimise the period of time when aircraft are grounded
events.summary: easyJet invested significantly in spares because supply-chain delays made just-in-time spares unviable.
events.title: Investment in spares to limit aircraft grounding

events.quote: The Committee reviewed easyJet’s credit rating position and noted the upgrade of rating from
events.summary: The audit committee reviewed easyJet's credit rating position and noted an upgrade of rating.
events.title: Credit rating upgrade noted by committee
